description:
Whenever your life total would be reduced to zero or less, Olag instead sets your life total to three and transforms into Ludevic, but remains a copy of Enduring Angel.
The next time your life total would be reduced to zero or less, Ludevic instead sets your life total to three and transforms into Olag, but remains a copy of Enduring Angel.
Repeat.

uses.name: Ludevic, Necrogenius // Olag, Ludevic's Hubris
uses.cardState: as a copy of Enduring Angel
